create_entry.default:
In the Zepp app, open the settings of the Home Assistant mini app and paste:

- the address: `{url}`
- the key: `{key}`

The key is the only secret of the watch: keep it private. Then choose what the watch shows, in the settings of the watch app or in the options of the integration.

user.description: Adds a watch running Zepp OS, which its phone connects with a key of its own. To tell several watches apart, rename them afterwards.

data_description.areas: These areas come first, in this order; the others follow by name.
data_description.entities: A page per area, in this order. They can also be chosen in the settings of the watch app, among the entities exposed to Assist.
data_description.favorites: The first page of the watch, in this order.
data_description.pipeline: Answers the voice messages. The preferred pipeline if empty.

init.description: To paste in the settings of the watch app — address: `{url}`, key: `{key}`
